notes.title: DEMO UPDATE
notes.content:
Hey there! Thanks for playing the demo. 
With this update most of annying stuff should be gone. 
[b]Keep the feedback coming, we are listening![/b]

New Stuff:
- Collected Mutagens will now add gene points during evolving. Each non-emmet species has it's own mutagen with distinct points (btw this is half of the Mutagen functionality)
- New Ship Module: DNA lab. For a price of silicon and your own ants you can make additional DNA points.

Balance:
- We removeed the flee behaviour when the Intimidation is much lower, because it generated too much confusion, we will restore it after making it more clear and fair
- Queen Life is a bit longer
- Spiderlings Intimidation is nerfed
- Skolopendra is a little bit nerfed - but it's also a bit bigger now, to better indicate it's strenght. Also fixed its health bar from not appearing.
- There's a bigger chance for more planets in the demo

Fixes:
- Fixed Scanning tutorial (and other tutorial bugs)
- Fixed spawning ants during a pause (it won't subtract the food now)
- Fixed Resource and Life detectors (ship upgrades)
- Fixed number of ants not displaying correctly in Colony Panel
- Fixed Popup that warns you if you want to launch in space but you have low ship health
- Fixed bad math in the Ship Repair menu
- Added Touch Event handle to Choose Galaxy Screen - it should work on touch screens, but I can't test it :)
- The performance should be a lot smoother (it's prepared to at least couple of hundreds of ants I hope 🤞 )
And more fixes and tweaks here and there. 

Feel free to join our [url=https://discord.gg/sfWwHke2wX]Discord[/url] for more news and early builds!

Cheers!

notes.title: Demo Update
notes.content:
First off, thank you all for trying out our demo! We've collected valuable feedback and wanted to address some issues as fast as possible.

Regarding the Content Update - you have to wait, but won't have to wait long.

Changelog:

[b]Balance:[/b]
[list]
[*] Increased the number of termites in the prologue.
[*] Adjusted Champion discovery difficulty by reducing some numbers.
[/list]

[b]Visual:[/b]
[list]
[*] Refined the visual representation of resources in uncovered but non-visible areas.
[/list]

[b]Fixes:[/b]
[list]
[*] Resolved the issue where the Buy Ants Menu would disappear if more than 3 classes were unlocked.
[*] Added a cancel button to the Unlock Ant Class Menu.
[*] Fixed a bug causing dropped resources to shrink and change meshes upon revisiting a planet.
[*] Rectified the bug where resources held by ants were not added to the player's inventory upon returning to the ship.
[*] Audio settings are now properly saved and refreshed.
[*] Game Success screen now displays the correct message.
[*] It's now possible to win the demo by conquering termites in the prologue (though it's not expected!).
[/list]

Cheers!

notes.title: Join The Playtest, Get The Free Copy
notes.content:
Slight change of plans: We are switching from an open beta to playtesting sessions with you! 

[b]Here's how it works:[/b] Fill out [url=https://docs.google.com/forms/d/1DjMM_I3FVIJu1fxcgdqnJ0l31hDc5blk9Rn0n-3F0Q4/]THIS FORM[/url], and we'll reach out to you as soon as possible. 

You have the option to play the game offline and provide feedback, BUT you can also [url=https://discord.com/invite/sfWwHke2wX]join our discord[/url] and choose to play live with screen sharing, allowing us to learn directly from your experience!

As this may be a bit of an inconvenience, we would like to compensate you with a [b]free copy of the game (Steam key).[/b]

We can't wait to see you!
